text:
Lina (CS): Heads-up — Sweeper Inc just submitted a bespoke security questionnaire. They want: KMS rotation logs for the last 90 days, audit log export (immutable proof), and a short statement on retention policy. Deadline: EOD Friday from their side. Escalating to Sec/Eng.

Dave (Security): Thanks. Do we have a standard evidence bundle for KMS rotations + HSM attestations? If not, we should confirm exactly what they mean by 'rotation proof' (timestamps + key IDs vs. HSM serial).

Maria (Eng): We can pull audit events and produce a signed export. Quick repro note for the export API: use our internal audit endpoint — e.g.

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_ADMIN" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/internal/audit/events?customer_id=sweeper&from=2024-10-01&to=2025-01-01" \
  -o sweeper-audit.ndjson
```

That produces NDJSON with event_type, ts, actor, resource, and an event_hash. We can package with a checksum and timestamped manifest.

Sarah (CS): Customer specifically asked for 'immutable log evidence' they can attach to their vendor review. Also they flagged a previous auth error that showed 401s on their integration last month — they want that included if possible.

Tim (Eng): I'll run the export and generate a presigned S3 link with a signed manifest. Plan: pull events, compute SHA256 of bundle, sign manifest with our private key (managed by vault). Will include key IDs for any KMS rotations. ETA 6 hours.

Dave (Security): For HSM attestation: we don't ship full HSM certs externally, but we can provide the KMS key metadata (key_id, created_on, rotation_events array) and a short statement that keys are backed by HSMs in our provider and managed per our KMS integration policy. If Sweeper needs vendor-signed HSM certs, we may need Legal approval.

Lina (CS): Also cc'ing Aisha from Legal for sign-off on what we can disclose to a 3rd party. Sweeper is an enterprise customer (contract M-2024-77).

Aisha (Legal): Confirming — OK to share audit export and key metadata. We should avoid sharing raw HSM cert chains or any internal provider PII. I can draft a vendor-ready attestation statement.

Maria (Eng): Reproducing the 401 Sweeper saw — found in our logs:

```text
2025-02-10T14:12:03Z ERROR token_validation failed for client_id=sweeper-integration reason=expired_token
2025-02-10T14:12:03Z WARN retry_attempt=1
```

Looks like a token rotation race. Recommend we include a short write-up: what happened, repro steps, and mitigation (increase token overlap window or graceful retry).

Sarah (CS): Please include that write-up in the bundle. Customer wants a single zipped package with: audit.ndjson, manifest+signature, key-rotation-summary.csv, and the 401 incident write-up.

Tim (Eng): Agreed. I'll produce: sweeper-evidence-20250210.zip -> presigned link + manifest (signed).

Lina (CS): Perfect. I'll set expectation with Sweeper that we'll deliver within 6 hours and loop in Legal if they request provider HSM certs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

logs-bot: export_job started for sweeper id=exp-9382 status=running

logs-bot: export_job completed id=exp-9382 status=success size=42.1MB presigned_url=https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-exports/sweeper-evidence-20250210.zip?sig=REDACTED

Tim (Eng): Uploaded bundle and signed manifest. Manifest SHA256=ae3f9b2... Link shared to Lina.

Lina (CS): Shared with Sweeper contact and confirmed receipt. Customer asked whether the same bundle can be used for their auditor — saying yes, but they'll forward any additional auditor questions. I'll keep this thread updated.

Aisha (Legal): Drafted a short attestation for key metadata; sent to Lina for inclusion.

Dave (Security): Adding note: recommend we add a small blurb in our KB about token rotation overlap settings to reduce recurrence. Filing follow-up ticket.

Lina (CS): Thanks everyone — closing the triage here but will reopen if auditor follows up.
